Senses.Explanation: Buddha Great Penetrating Wisdom Victory is the pre-Chan Buddha whom Zen speakers invoke through the ten-kalpa sitting and non-manifest awakening case. Teachers quote the verse, ask why the way did not manifest, and turn the ancient figure into a present public question.
